summary: Top-down round 5. Did NOT reach the explicit all-n N_n, but produced load-bearing structural results that sharpen the search: (1) RULED OUT the literal box-spline-of-omega^2 closed form (retires my s2_008) on two independent grounds -- A_n has a genuine pole (not piecewise-poly) and N_n is ODD (a box spline of the even knots omega_i^2 is even); the closed form must be a truncated-power spline in LEG variables. (2) Showed the simple-pole residue is irreducibly CHAMBER/BRANCH-dependent (depends on signed-minus invariants AND chamber; same matched magnitudes give unrelated residues), which both kills the global-residue shortcut and explains the PI's 'N_6 is algebraic in the invariants' negative. (3) Re-confirmed exactly: A_6 even + Z_2-swap-invariant; (1=2) jump order 3, (1=1) jump order 1; the soft recursion on N_n. Built a validated in-process exact BG evaluator (fastbg.py) and ran a literature pass (no published closed form exists).
